intro.fr: Rayman 2: The Great Escape se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Rayman 2: The Great Escape can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Aeltumn/Rayman2AP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Rayman 2: The Great Escape.
text.en: The GitHub repository Aeltumn/Rayman2AP, home of the Rayman 2: The Great Escape APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.0.2.
text.en: The first version, v0.0.2, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.3.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (20 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.3.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (20 versions released).

text.fr: Rayman 2: The Great Escape figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Rayman 2: The Great Escape is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
